description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Mobile, which extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice. It contains logic for detecting mobile user agents based on signatures and user agent string analysis, as well as methods for retrieving device capabilities and features related to mobile browsers.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Mobile
classes.description: A class for detecting and handling mobile user agents, including identifying device types and capabilities.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Static method to determine if a user agent string or server environment matches a mobile device signature.

methods.name: userAgentStart
methods.description: Static method to check if the first four characters of a user agent string match known mobile prefixes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the mobile user agent detection object with optional user agent string, server info, and configuration.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'mobile' indicating the device type.

methods.name: _defineFeatures
methods.description: Defines and retrieves device features and capabilities based on detection.

methods.name: getMarkupLanguage
methods.description: Determines the markup language (HTML, WML, XHTML) to use based on device features.

methods.name: getImageFormatSupport
methods.description: Returns supported image formats for the device.

methods.name: getMaxImageHeight
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported image height.

methods.name: getMaxImageWidth
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported image width.

methods.name: getPhysicalScreenHeight
methods.description: Returns the physical screen height of the device.

methods.name: getPhysicalScreenWidth
methods.description: Returns the physical screen width of the device.

methods.name: getXhtmlSupportLevel
methods.description: Returns the level of XHTML support.

methods.name: hasFlashSupport
methods.description: Indicates whether the device supports Flash.

methods.name: hasPdfSupport
methods.description: Indicates whether the device supports PDF.

methods.name: hasPhoneNumber
methods.description: Indicates whether the device has an associated phone number.

methods.name: httpsSupport
methods.description: Indicates whether the device supports HTTPS.
